data.name: Ato
data.gender_notes: Ato is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ato is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘atma’ meaning self or soul. In Hinduism, it symbolizes the vital breath or the life force that sustains all living beings. The name is often used in spiritual contexts to invoke the divine presence within. The name Ato carries the meaning “Breath, Vital Force” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ato usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, vital force and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ato belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath, Vital Force.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ato total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
